title: Order Desk Note: Ordered Supply of VendPoint Start-Up Items to the Same Ship-To
content:
When the item most recently added to a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine also reaches the machine's ship-to on ordinary orders, Corbett's start-up par review sizes the machine's par for that item at a share, according to the order lines shipped to that ship-to under its Ship-To Fulfillment Account.

**Rule.** The order channel factor follows the units of the item shipped on order lines to the machine's ship-to in the three months ending today: when those shipped units are above zero and at least the item's units, the factor is the heavy order share; when they are above zero and below the item's units, the factor is the light order share; otherwise the factor is one.

**The item's units** are the units of that item vended from the machine in the three months ending today, less the units of that item returned to the machine or credited for a vend error in the same three months, each record counted by its date.

Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

**Figures.** Heavy order share 0.75; light order share 0.9.

| Units shipped on order lines to the ship-to, three months | Compared with the item's units | Factor |
|---|---|---|
| Above zero | At least the item's units | 0.75 |
| Above zero | Below the item's units | 0.9 |
| Zero | not applicable | 1 |

Hypothetical figures: with 40 item units from the machine, 40 units shipped give 0.75, 39 units give 0.9 and no shipped units give 1.
